title: Book 8 — Urania, Chapter 32
paragraphs: When, however, they passed from Doris into Phokis, they did not capture the Phokians themselves. Some of them had gone up to the heights of Parnassos — there is a summit of Parnassos very suited to receive a large number, standing by itself near the city of Neon, called Tithorea. There some of them had brought up their goods and taken refuge themselves; but most had carried their belongings across to the Ozolian Locrians, to the city of Amphissa, which stands above the Crissaian plain. The barbarians, however, overran the whole Phokian land — the Thessalians led their army so — and whatever they came upon as they marched they burned or cut down, delivering both the cities and the temples to the flames.
